mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% eases monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5%, labor market tightness increases, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected wage growth and consumption boosts.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between UNRATE and wage growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during high INDPRO growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broadening consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:co-movement between HOUST and RSAFS in past expansions
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) hike above 5% in a tightening cycle, while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 5%, may signal the economy's resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening cycles with low UNRATE are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the labor market's influence on the economy is persistent, thus the unemployment rate (UNRATE) will consistently predict S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, with lower UNRATE corresponding to higher returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window, or the relationship between UNRATE and SPX returns becomes insignificant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 1% MoM signals a strong rebound, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of post-shock instances when INDPRO MoM growth > 1%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
